senses.gloss: m. (v. סוֹף) metal spike at the butt-end of the spear (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Hasta).
units: Targ. II Sam. XXI, 16 (h. text קֵין).—*Pl. (in Hebr. dict.) סוֹפִינֵי.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 5:6">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. V, 6</cite> <he>תלוי זיני וס׳</he> ed. Zolk. (ed. Zuck. <cite ref="O01347"><he>ספטני</he></cite>) the handles of weapons and spikes.
